compose_gtn_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs and verify the resulting composed graph
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a weighted finite-state transducer graph using log-sum-exp
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a weighted finite-state transducer graph
union_concat_closure_graphs: perform union, concatenation, or Kleene closure operations on weighted finite-state transducer graphs
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a weighted finite-state transducer graph to simplify it
